questions.question: Before the battle against his son Absalom, how did King David order his commanders to treat Absalom?
Why did King David's people plead with him not to go out to battle against Absalom's army?

answers.text: The king was worth ten thousand of them
Absalom's army was far too big
The king had never led them in battle

questions.question: As Absalom rode his mule under a large oak in the forest, what part of him got caught fast in the branches?
After Joab and his men killed Absalom in the forest, what did they do with Absalom's body?

answers.text: Threw him in a pit under stones
Carried him back to King David
Buried him in his father's tomb
